# A directory named on the command line is served like the working
# directory: its index page at the root, or a listing when it has none.

md2html -http :9142 site &
wait-port :9142
curl -s http://localhost:9142/
stdout 'Site home'
curl -s http://localhost:9142/guide
stdout 'Guide body'

md2html -http :9143 plain &
wait-port :9143
curl -s http://localhost:9143/
stdout 'Index of /'
stdout 'notes'

-- site/README.md --
# Site

Site home.
-- site/guide.md --
# Guide

Guide body.
-- plain/notes.md --
# Notes
